meta.format: RGBA8888 (Pillow); an indexed copy made with pngquant sits beside it as <name>.q.png

packing.note: Untrimmed grid: one row per animation, 2 px gutter, frame = sourceSize, pivot at the anchor.

pivot.note: image centre = the tower spot (MANIFEST BeachGround anchor)

body.note: static ground: no hitbox. body r = half the image width; scale the ground by cover-fit to the viewport, not by an enemy radius

meta.license: Original art generated for Brian Awsumb's Last Stand Tower with Grok Bot GenerateImage; no third-party packs.
meta.fit: cover, centred on the screen centre (= the tower)

provenance.postProcess: _tools/background.py: 2x LANCZOS upscale to 1536x2048 (the generator's max is 768x1024, so the art is upscaled, not authored at 1536)

meta.knownIssue: a starfish decoration sits at the right edge beside the pause button at 390x844 (CSS ~385,760); not moved: the ground must stay centred on the tower, and a symmetric crop-zoom big enough to push it off-screen would also push the shoreline under the top HUD

quantizedCopy.metric: PSNR / max error on premultiplied RGBA (colour under alpha 0 ignored)
